description: This file contains a mock implementation of the Akka Persistence SnapshotStore for testing purposes. It logs invocations, forwards delete operations to a Mockito mock, and handles specific failure scenarios based on the persistence ID.

classes.name: MockSnapshotStorePlugin
classes.description: A mock implementation of the Akka Persistence SnapshotStore for testing purposes, including methods for loading, saving, deleting snapshots, and verification.

methods.name: doLoadAsync
methods.description: Loads a snapshot asynchronously based on persistence ID and criteria. Returns a default SelectedSnapshot wrapped in a Future.

methods.name: doSaveAsync
methods.description: Saves a snapshot asynchronously, logging the operation.

methods.name: doDeleteAsync (metadata)
methods.description: Deletes a snapshot based on metadata asynchronously, forwarding the call to a Mockito mock and handling failure scenario.

methods.name: doDeleteAsync (persistenceId, criteria)
methods.description: Deletes snapshots based on persistence ID and criteria asynchronously, forwarding the call and simulating failure if applicable.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that a delete operation was called on the Mockito mock with matching parameters.

methods.name: matchesCriteria
methods.description: An internal helper that creates an ArgumentMatcher to verify the maximum sequence number in delete criteria.
